findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/evidence.js::run-event.schema.json is not classified additive by classifyschemachange
findings.title: run-event.schema.json is not classified additive by classifySchemaChange
findings.action: Teach walkSchemaChange to diff discriminator.mapping values, then assert additivity for run-event.schema.json
findings.disposition_rationale: A pre-existing limitation of the classifier, which compares a discriminator by equality, so any new event data key hits it. The spec lists events/run-start for additivity, and the new test asserts that and checks run-event for the property. The repo's governance-check runs the evidence-schema leg in report mode, so the base-commit leg never fails on it. Filed as discovered scope rather than widening this PR to a classifier change.

occurrences.title: run-event.schema.json is not classified additive by classifySchemaChange

findings.disposition_rationale: stripVersion now drops faff_version with schema_version, so a restamp never reads as a changed path.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/contract-defs-evidence.js::downstream readers of custody-verdict and merge-record may reject the new key
findings.title: Downstream readers of custody-verdict and merge-record may reject the new key
findings.action: Confirm the readers are key-tolerant or add an admission test
findings.refutation: computeCustodyVerdictAdmission checks run_id, issue, classification and the digest, with no closed key set; disposition.js reads merge-record fields by name. The end-to-end custody tests (faff-893, faff-895) admit a stamped verdict through merge-gate and pass.
findings.disposition_rationale: Both readers pick fields by name; no closed key set exists.

occurrences.title: Downstream readers of custody-verdict and merge-record may reject the new key
